verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a company-incorporation/legal-paperwork service (EIN, incorporation docs, SAFEs, 83(b) filings); there is no evidence of a data export feature or open-format data portability for users to leave with their data. The only related item is viewing incorporation documents in a dashboard tab, which is not a bulk export in open formats, and no evidence discusses exporting or migrating data out of Atlas.
